info.name: Lookup full-access accounts by public key

params.name: public_key
params.description: NEAR public key in `ed25519:...` or `secp256k1:...` form.

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional API key forwarded by embedded portal clients. The public FastNEAR API does not require it.

items.docs: Fetch the account IDs that have registered a full-access public key, via the legacy V0 lookup path.
